metadata.article_title: Provisions of this Code to override other laws.

article.title: Provisions of this Code to override other laws.
article.content:
238Provisions of this Code to override other laws.

Section 238  ·  Part V  ·  page 143 of the Act
The provisions of this Code shall have effect, notwithstanding anything inconsistent therewith contained in any other law for the time being in force or any instrument having effect by virtue of any such law.
